bottom_line: In ATHENA, dronedarone (400 mg twice a day) vs placebo reduced the primary outcome of first hospitalization due to cardiovascular events or death (hazard ratio, 0.76 [95% CI, 0.69 to 0.84]).
implications: These results support that, in this trial population, dronedarone vs placebo reduced the composite of first hospitalization due to cardiovascular events or death (734 [31.9%] vs 917 [39.4%]; hazard ratio 0.76 [95% CI, 0.69 to 0.84]) and reduced cardiovascular death (63 [2.7%] vs 90 [3.9%]; hazard ratio 0.71 [95% CI, 0.51 to 0.98]) but did not demonstrate a significant reduction in death from any cause (hazard ratio 0.84 [95% CI, 0.66 to 1.08]). The document also reports higher rates of specific adverse events and more discontinuation due to adverse events with dronedarone.

major_points.text: Multicenter randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in patients with atrial fibrillation.
major_points.quote: ATHENA was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial conducted according to the Declaration of Helsinki at 551 centers in 37 countries.

major_points.text: 4628 patients were randomized to dronedarone 400 mg twice daily or placebo.
major_points.quote: We conducted a multicenter trial to evaluate the use of dronedarone in 4628 patients with atrial fibrillation who had additional risk factors for death. Patients were randomly assigned to receive dronedarone, 400 mg twice a day, or placebo.

major_points.text: Primary outcome was first cardiovascular hospitalization or death from any cause.
major_points.quote: The primary study outcome was the first hospitalization due to cardiovascular events or death from any cause.

major_points.text: Primary outcome occurred less often with dronedarone than placebo.
major_points.quote: The primary outcome occurred in 734 patients (31.9%) in the dronedarone group and in 917 patients (39.4%) in the placebo group, with a hazard ratio for dronedarone of 0.76 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.69 to 0.84; P<0.001).

major_points.text: Death from any cause did not differ significantly between groups.
major_points.quote: There were 116 deaths (5.0%) in the dronedarone group and 139 (6.0%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.84; 95% CI, 0.66 to 1.08; P = 0.18).

major_points.text: Dronedarone had higher rates of several adverse events including bradycardia and QT prolongation.
major_points.quote: The dronedarone group had higher rates of bradycardia, QT-interval prolongation, nausea, diarrhea, rash, and an increased serum creatinine level than the placebo group.

criticisms.text: High premature discontinuation rate may underestimate benefit and limit likelihood of demonstrating increase in adverse events.
criticisms.quote: Another limitation of this trial is that the rate of premature discontinuation of the study drug was very high (30.2% in the dronedarone group). This may have resulted in an underestimate of the benefit of dronedarone, but it also may have limited the likelihood of demonstrating an increase in the rate of adverse events.

criticisms.text: No active-comparator antiarrhythmic trial for this outcome; relative efficacy/safety vs other drugs not known.
criticisms.quote: Therefore, it is not possible to know the relative efficacy or safety of dronedarone as compared with other drugs for this outcome.
